policies.evidence-boundary: Do not make claims stronger than available evidence; distinguish observation, inference, judgment, and external validation.
policies.loop-boundary: Do not present L1 execution as resolution of L2 human judgment or L3 external feedback.
policies.context-minimization: Load only context required by the current deliverable; do not scan files merely because they exist.
policies.idempotent-checks: Reuse successful valid discovery/check results; rerun only after expiry, relevant change, failure, or explicit request.
policies.user-file-safety: Preserve user-authored files and project-local state; do not overwrite or delete them implicitly.
policies.resource-portability: Do not assume machine-local data, cache, runtime, or accelerator resources exist on another machine.
